scenes.text: Volume tells how many cubic units fit in a solid. Multiply length times width times height.
Find the volume of a 3 times 7 times 5 cuboid. The answer is 105 cm cubed . Volume equals length times width times height equals 3 times 7 times 5 equals 105 cm cubed .
A storage box in a craft workshop holds 3 by 6 by 2 unit cubes. What is its volume? Pause the video and think.

A storage box in a craft workshop holds 3 by 6 by 2 unit cubes. What is its volume? The answer is 36 cm cubed . Volume equals length times width times height equals 3 times 6 times 2 equals 36 cm cubed .
